title: Toysery Airbus A380 Bump and Go Airplane Toy, Lights & Sounds, Ages 3-12
features: 🛫 Realistic Airbus A380 Model: This large toy plane replicates the iconic A380 passenger jet in high-quality ABS plastic. Its detailed cockpit, wings and landing gear spark imaginative play, and built-in 360° rolling wheels let children push or bump it for continuous flight action.

🔄 “Bump & Go” Obstacle Avoidance: Built-in smart sensors detect collisions; when the plane hits an object it automatically turns and navigates around it. No remote needed – just switch it on and watch it roll nonstop, keeping kids engaged with hands-free, autonomous play.

💡 Flashing LED Lights & Realistic Sounds: Multicolor LED lights flash from the nose and engines, and authentic jet engine sounds play during motion. Kids love the sensory excitement – the lights and sounds easily turn off with a switch if quieter play is needed.

⚙️ Easy Setup & Safe Construction: Simply snap on the wings and insert 3 AA batteries (not included to start. Made of sturdy non-toxic plastic with smooth, rounded edges, this indoor toy is durable and toddler-friendly, designed to withstand energetic play with no small parts.

🎁 Great Gift for Ages 3–12: A perfect birthday or holiday gift, this airplane thrills boys and girls alike. It encourages imaginative pretend play and enhances hand-eye coordination as little pilots re-create takeoffs and landings. (Manufacturer recommends ages 3–144 months.
